headline: Do I need to heal before my soulmate arrives?

voc.why: NO PULL RAN. Written 2026-08-20 from the money family's proven shape (cards-my-energy) and the standing soulmate bans, at the operator's direction ("write the beats first"). 🔴 Same exposure as its sibling. Pull before any spend.

note:
Test B — soulmate × keyword (2026-08-20). HEALING rung, WHY.

FRAME: no man. Must not fall through to decode-him.

🔴🔴 THE HEADLINE ASKS EVELYN TO CONFIRM A PRECONDITION, and confirming it is banned. 'Yes, heal first' is the exact sentence BLAME_BANS pins as gating love on her fixing herself, and it is also the single most common thing she has already been told for free.

🔴 THE 'NO' IS NOT A RULING ON HER HEALING EITHER — see cards-waiting-to-heal. The read refuses the SEQUENCE, not the healing. Healing is not denied, minimised, or prescribed; it is simply not a gate with a keeper on it.

🔴 NO HEALTH, NO THERAPY LANGUAGE, NO DIAGNOSIS. No trauma, attachment, inner child, nervous system, shadow work, 'do the work'. Meta-prohibited and outside a card's reach.

🔴 NO COACHING OF ANY KIND — this headline pulls hardest toward advice, and advice is what the whole family bans. No 'just live your life', no 'stop trying', no 'it comes when you're not looking'. Those are strategies wearing a kind voice.

⚠ MUST NOT RESTATE `cards-waiting-to-heal` (who is waiting on whom) and must not restate `cards-not-found-yet` (no fault to hand her).

The finding: there is no before. It does not run in order — and she has been holding a queue of her own making, with love filed last.

⚠ THE BRIDGE PARAPHRASES, AND IT HAS TO. Cut 2 normally echoes her ad almost verbatim, but this headline CONTAINS a banned phrase — 'do I need to heal before' is the exact string BLAME_BANS pins as gating love on her fixing herself, so echoing it puts the ban in Evelyn's mouth on all three cards. The guard's restatement exemption cannot save it either: it tests whether the clause is a SUBSTRING of the headline, and `You asked if…` never is. So the bridge says 'if healing comes first, before your soulmate' — same question, her words, no banned string. Any future family whose ad quotes a banned idea back needs the same treatment, or an explicit beat-2 exemption in its own guard file.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — all four things are on the table at once, not one after another.
You asked if healing comes first, before your soulmate. Your hand went to the card where it is all out together.
So there is no before, dear. Nothing on that table is waiting its turn.
And all four sit there at once, dear. None of them is first.
But you've been running yours in order, dear. This, then that, then love.
That's why love keeps sliding down the list, dear. It has been last for years.
Let me look closer at what put love at the end of that list…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — the wood he hangs from has green leaves still coming out of it.
You asked if healing comes first, before your soulmate. Your hand went to the card where two things happen at once.
So it does not go in order, dear. On this card the mending and the hanging are the same moment.
And the leaves come out of cut wood, dear. Straight out of the cut, not after it.
But you've been waiting for one to finish, dear, so the other can start.
That's why you feel behind, dear. You've been queueing for a door that is open.
Let me look closer at what keeps you stood at that door…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — his foot is already off the rock and the flower is still in his hand.
You asked if healing comes first, before your soulmate. Your hand went to the card that goes anyway.
So no, dear. Nothing on this card was finished before it started.
And the step and the flower happen together, dear. Not one, then the other.
But you've set yourself a mark to reach first, dear.
That's why not yet has become your answer, dear. To yourself, mostly.
Let me look closer at what set that mark where it is…
